Subject: Fenwick Warehousing - Referral Required

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the Fenwick Warehousing submission. I've reviewed the materials, and everything looks complete—appreciate the thorough package!

However, I need to refer this to our senior underwriting team before proceeding. Our appetite for Louisiana accounts requires additional review and approval at a higher level due to regional exposure considerations.

I'll present this internally and circle back with you shortly. In the meantime, if you'd like a faster turnaround, you might also consider reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on Gulf Coast risks—they may have more streamlined appetite for Louisiana warehousing.

I'll be in touch soon with next steps.

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
